depends_on: Nagornyi 1976 classification of irreducibles of GL_2(Z/p^r), p odd
notes: a(p^r) = p^(r-1)(p+1) except a(2) = 2; with multiplicativity a(2n) = 2 psi(n). Odd p cited (Nagornyi 1976). p = 2 by Clifford theory over N = K_ceil(r/2): scalar beta reduces to level r-1 by a det twist; non-scalar beta gives [G:G_beta] = 3*2^(2r-1-2l), 2^(2r-1-2l), 3*2^(2r-2-2l); for r odd the split case has a stable extension and a non-degenerate commutator form on G_beta/M = (Z/2)^2, so dim sigma = 2. Outside Lean: all. GAP CharacterDegrees checked a(2^r) = 3*2^(r-1) for r = 2..7 (up to GL_2(Z/128)), a(25) = 30, a(27) = 36, data n = 2..24, and a(2n) = 2 psi(n) for 2n = 2..32, 36, 48, 54 (certificate/*.out). Argument only: r >= 8, odd prime powers in general (Nagornyi, cited), and the general identity.
